verdict.rationale: Box is a content platform with automation surfaces (Box AI agent configurations, webhooks, event-driven extraction), so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no version history, change review, or rollback for any automation or agent configuration. Webhooks, events, and the visual agent configurator are adjacent features that do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
